title: [review] stack.rs: Security invariant enforced only in debug builds
description: The epoch >= 128 requirement (per spec section 4.4) uses debug_assert!, which is stripped in release builds. A caller could pass epoch < 128 in production, violating the security invariant. Should use assert! or return Result for security-critical invariants.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed debug_assert! to assert! for epoch >= 128 check. Security invariants must be enforced in all builds, not just debug. Also added SECURITY comment explaining the rationale.
